title: Bag of bricks- Dark Red 25
descriptionHtml:
Dark Red — colour 25

A deep burgundy with real richness. Dark Red handles the shadowed side of anything red — roses, fabric, lips — and brings drama to portraits without resorting to black.

Works well with: Red 26, Rouge 38, Coffee 14

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Dark Red bricks (colour 25) for Memobrick mosaics. A deep burgundy for rich shadows, roses and dramatic contrast in portrait work.
